messages:
ash: quick concept drop: "spillback probe" — frontdoor sometimes returns a short-lived probe token instead of 429 during tiny capacity hiccups. probe asks clients to poll a /status endpoint. aim: keep sessions alive without a full queue infra.

leo: sounds lightweight. practically how long is token valid? and do we charge anything at issue time?

ash: default 4s TTL, configurable per-route. charge a tiny "probe token" cost so tenants can't spam free probes. also enforce per-client probe rate cap.

tess: auth: MAC the token (route + client_id + nonce) to avoid spoofing and replays. include a one-time nonce and short TTL. log token replays.

leo: fairness: probes should be admitted at probability proportional to tenant weight, but also dampened by recent failure rate to avoid noisy tenants hogging probes. suggest prob p ~ weight/(weight + beta*recent_err).

ops-bot: deploy note: implement per-edge counters to enforce local caps; keep tokens stateless so no cross-node coordination. dry-run mode: emit events but still return 429s.

ash: worker flow: probe -> worker polls claim(token) -> worker gets lease_id -> complete/abort. lease TTL small (1-2s). on worker crash token can be reissued once with retry limit.

tess: telemetry: probe_issued, probe_consumed, probe_expired, probe_replay, per-tenant_probe_rate, probe_success_ratio. alert if expiry_rate > 3% or single client accounts for >40% probes in 1m.

leo: SDK impact minimal: auto-poll with jitter and expose "pending" state. server exposes /claim and /complete endpoints. keep SDK backward compatible.

ash: edge-cases: kvcache misses for delayed probes — flag ML workloads for evals. also provide a kill-switch and per-tenant opt-out.

tess: security note: rotate MAC keys and include route/version in signature to avoid stale tokens. add replay detector to security logs.

ash: next step I'll open a short RFC with proto sketch, knobs (probe_ttl, probe_cost_tokens, max_probes_per_client_min, lease_ttl, retry_limit), telemetry, and rollout plan. tagging @leo @tess for quick review.

leo: LGTM. add a quick perf target: fast-path p50 impact < 0.5%.
